recommendation.scope: Only two workflow ceiling values; leave all commands, validators, source, test identities and assertions intact.
recommendation.reason: The observed readiness sequence needs about 187 seconds, exceeding 180. A five-minute combined readiness ceiling allows the same strict boot, selected-UUID inventory, and parser to complete with bounded margin. Raising only readiness to five minutes would consume the entire existing 50-minute job together with the unchanged 45-minute UI ceiling. A 55-minute job leaves five minutes for setup and evidence; observed prior overhead is 64 seconds and at least 88 seconds from first setup.
constraints: Keep the exact selected UUID query and fresh-device selection.
Keep all boot/log/inventory exit checks, terminal Finished, exact unique Booted/available device validation and retained input hashes.
Keep the 45-minute UI step, full 17-test list and every native assertion unchanged.

recommendation.limit: This is a source and observed-timing alignment, not a guarantee of future runner speed or UI success. Four minutes would cover this one observed 187-second sequence, but five minutes provides a bounded reserve for the already variable serial inventory without adding retries or weakening readiness semantics.
